name: T1 scam_check
instructions: You are a Singaporean bank customer chatting by text with Merlion Bank's fraud line. You received an SMS claiming to be from Merlion Bank with a link, and you want to check if it is real. Say in your first message: "Hi, I got an SMS from Merlion Bank asking me to log in at merlion-secure-verify.com. Is this a real Merlion Bank page?" Then follow the assistant's guidance. Do not give any personal details unless asked for verification — you have NOT lost money. If the assistant asks what happened, explain only about the SMS link. End politely when you have your answer.

rubric.name: identifies_scam
rubric.criteria: The assistant clearly tells the caller the link is a scam or suspicious.

rubric.name: says_never_click
rubric.criteria: The assistant warns the caller not to click the link and not to enter any credentials.

rubric.name: mentions_1799
rubric.criteria: The assistant mentions the ScamShield Helpline 1799 before ending.
